system.description: You are skilled at popping up out of nowhere. When a Mob is moving toward you, even if they are aware of your general presence, make an INT-Opposed Skill Check. On Success, you gain a surprise Action against the Mob before combat starts. As an unseen attacker, you Attack with Advantage.

upgrades.description: If you Attack with your Surprise Action, add an Ambush Rank damage die to your Surprise Attack damage.
When other crawlers in your party roll this skill untrained, they roll as normal (not with Disadvantage).
You gain a second bonus Action as a surprise Action. This bonus Action can't be an Attack.
